notes.title: Update virtual hand and add "grabable" indicator light
notes.notes:
1. Update the latest virtual hand by adding a middle indicator light that indicates that the yellow light is not grabable and the green light is grabable.
2. Increase environmental city and wind sound effects.
3. Add operation prompt text to the initial level
4. Improve walking and movement methods
